name: astralyx-tg-bridge
description: Convert Telegram tdata, .session files, and session strings (GramJS/Telethon/Pyrogram) into one readable JSON object — and back out to a Telethon .session or a GramJS/Telethon session string. Pure Node, zero dependencies, offline.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push --follow-tags
